reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 2 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 53 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.
